reply.text: This is a recovery-from-surgery question, which is a medical one. I'm not going to clear you to train or tell you what's safe after a procedure like that. Please check with your dentist or oral surgeon before you lift, since they know exactly what was done and what they want you to avoid. Once they've cleared you, tell me what they said and I'll keep your training around it. For now, rest and follow their aftercare instructions.
